lines.1: 「The weather's looking worse by the minute.」
lines.2: The club members had joined us in the council room, and we were having tea.
lines.3: The Princess and Otome sat with perfect posture, sipping elegantly.
lines.4: Those two were truly picturesque when they kept quiet.
lines.5: Surprisingly, even Nagomi looked perfectly at home sitting straight and proper.
lines.6: Meanwhile, Crab munched noisily on cookies while reading a manga that had come out today.
lines.7: 「Honestly! I don't remember raising such an ill-mannered child.」
lines.8: 「Come now, you little crab monster. Mind your manners.」
lines.10: 「Oh, my. Throwing around a word like 'die' so casually...」
lines.11: 「Dear, have you seen that child's manners? I'm simply mortified.」
lines.12: 「I told you I was leaving her upbringing to you.」
lines.13: 「But she's at that rebellious age. She won't listen to a word I say.」
lines.15: 「Um... It isn't really such a formal occasion, so I think enjoying ourselves is what matters.」
lines.17: 「Please don't talk with your mouth full!」
lines.18: 「That way of talking is disgusting, so please stop.」
lines.19: 「You wouldn't know this, Nagomi, but I've practically been a parent to Crab.」
lines.20: 「That still doesn't justify talking in such a disgusting way.」
lines.23: 「Nagomin, being so prickly is bad for your complexion.」
lines.24: 「I do not... care that much about beauty.」
lines.25: The sky had grown properly overcast.
lines.26: 「Good thing I brought an umbrella. Hey, Coconut, say 'Please let me under it' and I'll give you ten seconds.」
lines.29: 「See, Leo? Aren't you glad you brought a folding umbrella like I told you?」
lines.37: 「Oh! It flashed as brightly as my future.」
lines.38: 「And went dark again in an instant.」
lines.42: 「You know... When thunder strikes, isn't some girl supposed to shriek and cling to a guy?」
lines.43: 「You probably shouldn't expect that from anyone here.」
lines.44: 「That lightning was beautiful. I hope it flashes again.」
lines.45: 「Hey, does getting hit by lightning really turn your hair into an afro? Coconut, go get struck and find out. With all the bad stuff you do, it'll come right for you.」
lines.48: Otome was silently sipping her tea, too.
lines.50: 「Miss Sato seems like the type who might...」
lines.51: 「I'd better get a flashlight ready in case the power goes out...」
lines.53: 「What a shame. At a time like this, you should rely on the men.」
lines.58: By nightfall, the weather had completely cleared up.
